description: Shared $defs for the IDPR v2.1.0 Definition Layer schemas. Every docs/contracts/v2/*.schema.json file $refs into this one instead of redefining these shapes. This file has no top-level 'type' of its own — it is only a $defs library.

id.description: Snake_case dotted identifier, same convention as v1's docs/contracts/rule_ir.schema.json predicate/rule ids.

source_ref.description: Same shape as v1's rule_ir.schema.json $defs.source_ref, reused unchanged for provenance.

authority_basis.description: Provisional enum, carried over from v1 norm_card_set authority_basis values plus statute_text/judicial_precedent/academic_theory added for v2. Open Question #10 (v2.1.0 section 25) — the full authority/provenance schema is not yet finalized; this is a first cut for schema-validation purposes.

element_expression.description: v2.1.0 section 8, Element Expression Grammar. Recursive tree: a leaf 'ref' node, or ALL/ANY/NOT/ONE_OF combining sub-expressions. Used uniformly wherever the design doc's prose shows either a full expression tree (OffenseDef slots) or a flat conjunctive list (ElementBundleDef.requires, DoctrineDef.requires examples) — this schema treats the flat-list examples as the implicit-ALL degenerate case of the same grammar, so there is exactly one requirement grammar across the whole Definition Layer.

not_expr.description: v2.1.0 section 8.4 / 4.3 — strong negation only. NOT never converts unresolved/missing evidence into satisfaction; that is a runtime-evaluation invariant enforced by the type checker (step 2), not something this structural schema can check.

one_of_expr.description: v2.1.0 section 8.3 — restricted operator, exactly-one-of mutually exclusive legal alternatives. Not a default-choice operator.

stage_effect.description: v2.1.0 section 11 / 17.4, runtime legal effect algebra. BAR is deliberately not a member (section 11: 'BAR는 v2.1.0 core operator로 두지 않는다').

stage.description: Section 12.1: Elements is an aggregation result, not a stage a doctrine effect defeats — so 'elements' is intentionally excluded here.

modification.description: Free text for now. Open Question #4 (v2.1.0 section 25) — the typed MODIFY payload taxonomy is not yet designed.

relation_evaluation.description: v2.1.0 section 10.1/10.2 — determines whether the runtime evaluates this relation symbolically or routes it to neural LegalElementAssessment.

conclusion_type.description: v2.1.0 section 13, Intermediate Legal Conclusions — the three typed conclusion levels a derivative-participation dependency (section 15.3/15.4) can require.
